title: Hexagonal Architecture — Companion Files
description: Runnable ports-and-adapters example: a user-registration domain service with repository and email ports, PostgreSQL and in-memory adapters, a composition root with an Express route, Vitest unit tests, a Unit of Work port for transactions, and a Python variant.
description_es: Ejemplo ejecutable de ports y adapters: un domain service de registro de usuarios con ports de repository y email, adapters PostgreSQL y en memoria, raíz de composición con ruta Express, tests unitarios con Vitest, un port Unit of Work para transacciones y una variante en Python.
